rules.rule: Questions go in one round before any edit; never ask afterwards
Only contract, compat, and needs-user findings are asked
must: \*\*contract\*\* — the fix changes an API contract

rules.rule: An unforeseen contract or compat change is deferred, not applied or asked
Commit gated on the checks' exit status in the same command
must: gated on exit status in the same command that\s+commits

rules.rule: One logical fix per commit, staged by path
must: Stage only the fix's files by path

rules.rule: Fix only the conversation's findings; never re-review
must: Never re-review the code to add findings

rules.rule: Report opens with the fixed/total/commits line read off git log
must: Read every count and hash off `git log`
